title: AI usage ingest v1: what the server accepts
description: The HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/ai-usage/ingest. Clients ignore properties they do not know.

versions.description: Contract versions the server accepts in the batch's 'schema', newest first.

max_age_days.description: Oldest usage_date accepted, in days before today (UTC).

rate_limit.description: Batches one account may send per window; null when the server does not limit them.

server_time.description: The server's clock, for checking the client's.

tools.description: Slugs of the AI tools the server knows and shows. Other valid slugs are accepted too.

issue_ref_sources.description: The values of attribution.issue_ref_source the server knows. Servers that leave it out know 'explicit' and 'env' only.
